key_insight: SGKDiv learns shared and specialized knowledge components within generative models, enabling selective downstream reuse while preserving generation quality.
engineering_relevance: The approach enables modular adaptation without SVD-based weight factorization, addressing parameter overhead associated with existing knowledge-diversion methods.
method: Build Knowledge Units from paired feed-forward channels while preserving native computational structure.
Route knowledge using a shared usage prior plus calibrated condition-specific adjustments.
Regularize allocation, diversity, and magnitude to learn specialization rather than impose fixed assignments.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports better in-distribution generation than dense and MoE baselines across diverse settings, and stronger downstream adaptation than representative PEFT methods across eight datasets.
watch_item: The abstract does not quantify performance gains or routing and regularization overhead, leaving deployment trade-offs unclear.
paper_title: Specificity-Guided Knowledge Diversion for Decomposable Generative Models
